task: Bitemporal key/value store (ae.bitemporal) with valid-time intervals, as-of reads, atomic transactions, diff and revisions
reasoning_summary: Designed an immutable coalesced Timeline per key and an append-only per-key list of (tx, Timeline) entries, so as-of reads are binary searches and no-op transactions are detected by timeline equality. Wrote 38 literal unit tests plus a seeded differential test against an array-per-transaction oracle, then passed on the first run. Five mutants were each killed by a named test.
